requires.n: Instant/Sorcery that Copies a Legendary Creature You Control without Bypassing Legend Rule

1704-4549-7752--227.notablePrerequisites: This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. See the widget below for calculations.
1704-4549-7752--227.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's second ability by tapping an untapped legendary creature you control, adding one mana.
Repeat until there are no more available creatures to tap.
Cast the first creature-copying spell, targeting Krark.
When you cast it, Krark and any additional copies of Krark trigger.
Resolve all Krark triggers, copying that spell for each flip you won, and returning that spell to your hand as long as you lost at least one flip.
Resolve each copy of that spell, creating a token copy of Krark each time.
If that spell is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
If you won every flip, instead resolve the spell itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the spell into your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 8 with the second creature-copying spell.
If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before both spells end up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.

339-574-677-955.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-574-677-955.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1981-2415-2842-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1981-2415-2842-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Blood Artist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

728-4484-4871-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
728-4484-4871-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie Druid.
When the Zombie Druid dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

4247-4871-5220-7806.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4247-4871-5220-7806.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

206-240-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
206-240-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

662-1651-2709-7839.description:
Cause Orcish Mechanics to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Orcish Mechanics by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Orcish Mechanics.
Repeat from step 2.

3177-5233-7857.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-4661.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-4661.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Hulking Metamorph and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-4661.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2928-3652-3661-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
2928-3652-3661-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

864-4377-7631.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness
When the Eternal Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

457-1792-4404-4985.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-4404-4985.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-1374-4460-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1374-4460-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

2292-5170-6132-7286.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1778-2173-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

856-997-5220-6900.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-997-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-997-5220-6900.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

290-1987-4423-6918.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Dreamstone Hedron by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Dreamstone Hedron.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2164-5759-5872.easyPrerequisites: You have another card in hand.
2164-5759-5872.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Screaming Nemesis indestructible.
2164-5759-5872.description:
Give Screaming Nemesis indestructible, if needed.
Cast Chain of Plasma by paying {1}{R}, dealing 3 damage to Screaming Nemesis and causing you to discard a card and copy Chain of Plasma targeting Screaming Nemesis
Taii Wakeen and Screaming Nemesis trigger.
Resolve the Taii Wakeen trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Screaming Nemesis trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Chain of Plasma copy, dealing 3 damage to Screaming Nemesis and causing you to discard a card and copy Chain of Plasma targeting Screaming Nemesis.
Repeat from step 3.

813-3603-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-3603-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1202-1737-2438-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Moonvessel.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, Myr Moonvessel and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

586-3967-5626-6112.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Fumulus's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Insect and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1558-2557-4076.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three members in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1558-2557-4076.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Burakos triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens and causing the defending player to lose 4 life.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2829-5365-5395.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
2829-5365-5395.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis' third ability and Piper Wright's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Piper Wright trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

526-1621-2959.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other nontoken creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-1621-2959.description:
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying {2}{R}, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any creature you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Wispweaver Angel token.
Repeat from step 2.

147-3331-5147-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
147-3331-5147-5220.description:
Cast Thunderous Debut by paying {6}{G}{G} and sacrificing an artifact, enchantment or token.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Thunderous Debut.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dualcaster Mage on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the copy of Thunderous Debut, causing you to look at the top twenty cards of your library and put Dualcaster Mage and up to one other creature card onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

907-943-2203-2597-4235.notablePrerequisites: Wild Growth attached to Selesnya Sanctuary.
907-943-2203-2597-4235.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding {G/W}{G}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, with the copy targeting Selesnya Sanctuary.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Selesnya Sanctuary.
Repeat.

1124-2034-3323-4356.description:
Activate Tevesh Szat's first loyalty ability by putting three loyalty counters on it, creating two 0/1 Thrull creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Thrulls, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Ral Zarek's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.

803-1593-3809-4508-5299.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure token.
"Pirate" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1593-3809-4508-5299.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {2}.
Furnace Celebration triggers, causing you to pay {2} to deal two damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

628-895-4073.notablePrerequisites: Darigaaz's Attendant does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-895-4073.description:
Activate Darigaaz's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Darigaaz's Attendant dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Darigaaz's Attendant, targeting any creature.
Repeat.

507-1837.description:
Whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, Possibility Storm triggers, exiling that spell and causing that player to exile a different card from their library that they would normally be able to cast.
Arcane Laboratory prevents them from casting that card or any other spells this turn.
